headline: New Jersey would bar artificial intelligence insurance claim denials
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

New Jersey would bar insurers from using artificial intelligence to deny homeowner, automobile, and flood insurance claims. Not passed. It cites the fear that an algorithm decides who gets hired, housed, or lent to.

23 measures in 13 jurisdictions cite the fear that AI is watching and identifying people.

2,248 measures tracked. 756 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
